approved.description: Human gate. false after Phase 1; the human flips it to true and commits to release the loop.

branch.description: Set by loop.sh on first run: poc/<YYYY-MM-DD>.

items.description: Phase 1 writes 15-30 items with origin:spec. Checkpoints may append origin:checkpoint items up to the hard cap of 40; further findings go to plans/REVIEW.md.

detail.description: What to build, 1–5 sentences. The task prompt sees only this item and SPEC.md.

check.description: Literal shell command run by loop.sh from repo root. Exit 0 = passes. null only with manual_reason.

manual_reason.description: Why no machine check exists. Required when check is null; the loop never sets passes:true on such items.

origin.description: checkpoint = inserted by a code-review finding during Phase 2.
